title: Finite-Sample Metric Non-Collapse for Geometrically Supervised Latent World Models in Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.07265v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We establish a finite-sample learning-to-control theory for geometrically supervised latent models of nonlinear deterministic systems. Geometric supervision is used only during training: simulator state, proprioception, or state estimates with independently validated metric and directional error bounds supply observable-state distances and tangent directions, while deployment remains observation- and action-conditioned. We introduce an encoder-only local--global metric hinge that enforces directional resolution and separated-state discrimination. Under regular observable-factor, coverage, finite-capacity approximation, and uniform $C^{1,1}$ hypotheses, a computable one-sided regularization regime has a strong selection property: with high probability, every approximate empirical minimizer is simultaneously pointwise co-Lipschitz and uniformly approximately semiconjugate to the controlled dynamics. translated_title: 控制中几何监督潜在世界模型的有限样本度量非坍缩
translated_abstract: 我们为非线性确定性系统的几何监督潜在模型建立了有限样本的学习到控制理论。几何监督仅在训练期间使用：模拟器状态、本体感觉或具有独立验证的度量和方向误差界限的状态估计提供可观测状态距离和切向方向，而部署仍以观测和动作条件为条件。我们引入了一个仅编码器的局部-全局度量铰链，以强制方向分辨率和分离状态判别。在规则可观测因子、覆盖、有限容量近似和一致$C^{1,1}$假设下，一个可计算的单边正则化机制具有强选择性质：以高概率，每个近似经验最小化器同时是逐点共利普希茨的，并且一致近似半共轭于受控动力学。近似、采样和优化误差被明确量化，导致非渐近的稳定性保证。
tldr: 本文提出了一个有限样本学习控制理论，通过几何监督和局部-全局度量铰链，确保潜在世界模型在部署时保持度量非坍缩和动力学一致性，并提供可计算的稳定性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a finite-sample learning-to-control theory using geometric supervision and a local-global metric hinge, ensuring metric non-collapse and dynamical consistency in latent world models with computable stability guarantees.
